steps.deviation: Turkey mince replaces chicken mince; rice is boiled from dry rather than microwave pouch.
Fusilli replaces orzo, so the packet time is the guide, 2 minutes short of al dente.
Fine egg noodles replace udon and cook in about 4 minutes.
Spinach replaces pak choi and wilts in about 1 minute, so no timing is recorded.
Boneless skinless thighs cook faster than skin-on, so about 6 minutes a side instead of 12 plus 8.
Tomato puree and chilli flakes replace gochujang, mirin and oyster sauce, which are not stocked.
Fine egg noodles replace instant ramen and cook in about 3 minutes.
